params.body:
## What

The blog becomes **Stories**, laid out like the rest of the site.

**Overview, `/{lang}/stories`:**
- The film at the top, under the header. It is the same hero as on the collection pages, with the path above the title. The video comes from the Studio (`siteSettings.stories`), else the Couture film from `config/sanity.php` until Hoet has a film without text.
- The featured story, chosen in the Studio, else the newest.
- "Meer stories", newest first.
- Two ways on: find a sales point, or become a partner (now `/contact`).

**A story, `/{lang}/stories/{slug}`:** built like a frame page (`.fd`). One image with Vergroten stays in view while the text scrolls past it. Then the frames the story chose as cards ("Monturen in dit artikel"), and more stories.

**A frame page** now lists, under the frame, the stories that chose it ("Stories over H8"). The frame cards in a story therefore lead to the frame, and the frame leads back.

**Article blocks:**
- A FAQ block (`faqBlock`): questions that fold open, with links in the answers.
- A `siteLink` mark that links to Contact or the FAQ page.
- An internal link to a FAQ question, which lands on `/faq#question`.

**No categories.** Hoet starts Stories without folders, and the Studio drops the category type (hoet-sanity, same branch name). The category pages, labels and sitemap entries are gone.

**Former addresses:**
- `/blog` → `/stories`, in one hop.
- `/blog/{slug}` → `/stories/{slug}`, in one hop. A slug renamed while it was still the blog goes straight to the current one.
- `/blog/categorie/{slug}` → `/stories`, in one hop.
- An article taken offline still answers 410.

Titles follow #89: "Stories - Hoet", and "<story> - Hoet".

## Checked

- Full suite: 484 tests, 483 pass. `BuildStampTest` fails in any git worktree, also on main. Pint passes.
- New `tests/Feature/StoriesTest.php` covers:
  - the overview, the featured choice and the film;
  - the story layout;
  - the former addresses;
  - the sitemap and the language switch;
  - the FAQ block and the Contact/FAQ links;
  - the stories row on a frame page.

  `BlogTest` is moved to `/stories`.
- Looked at locally on desktop and mobile, with Hoet's two articles and images as demo content. No content was written to Sanity.

## After merge

- Hoet enters the articles in the Studio, once the hoet-sanity PR is merged and the Studio is deployed.
- Stories shows in the menu once **Stories tonen** is switched on in the Studio.
params.title: Stories: the blog as a page with a film, a featured story and frame-style articles
